summary: Register Medusa as a self-hosted storefront provider (products/inventory/prices/orders/returns) reusing the existing host-injected ProductReader/ProductWriter/PriceWriter registry boundary.

impacts.evidence: Medusa accounts are tenant-scoped Connector SDK accounts identical in shape to woocommerce/opencart/prestashop; the host is admin-supplied per-account non-secret runtime config, the same pattern every self-hosted storefront connector already uses.
The single opaque admin API key stays behind the existing SecretAccessor/UseSecret boundary; product/order projections retain only bounded remote ids, titles, statuses and amounts.
Medusa reuses the existing generic product/price sync machinery verbatim; no new public HTTP/OpenAPI operation is added.
No EventBus schema is added or changed.

Connector SDK root Connector/Runtime remain frozen; Medusa implements only existing capability-specific ports (ProductReader/Writer, InventoryReader/Writer, PriceReader/Writer, OrderReader, OrderStatusWriter, ReturnReader, CommerceWebhookReceiver), no port is added or changed.
No schema change; Medusa uses the same generic non-secret runtime-config store every runtime_config_template connector already uses.

Fixed admin-supplied host, opaque single-secret admin API key behind SecretAccessor, bounded inputs and normalized errors preserve the provider boundary. Product create and webhook receipt return a normalized unsupported error with no faked success, since neither has a safe/verifiable implementation on Medusa's current REST surface.

Payment- and CRM-style capability gates are unaffected; products.write/prices.write/inventory.write/orders.status.write remain gated by the same capability checks every storefront connector already uses.
Writes flow through the existing fetch-compare-write-reconcile receipt path; no new evidence shape is introduced.

Writes follow the existing fetch-compare-write-reconcile pattern (see docs/connectors/medusa/reconciliation.md); ambiguous transport failures reconcile against a re-fetch rather than retrying blindly.

Outbound authority is the admin-configured store host only, DNS-pinned through the existing SSRF-safe transport; inbound webhook receipt is explicitly unsupported in this task (see capability-audit.md), not silently unverified.
Non-2xx responses and malformed bodies are normalized to bounded errors.
Medusa can be disabled by removing its connector accounts; no schema rollback is needed.

Provider tests, go build/vet/test and the Task-064 conformance candidate pass 12 of 13 checks -- sandbox_isolation could not be exercised because this execution environment cannot create unprivileged Linux user namespaces, an environment constraint shared by every connector's Task-029 probe. docs/connectors/medusa/conformance-report.json records this genuine result rather than a fabricated pass.
